svg.text: McCzarny recently focused heavily on his dcvis
and crater-js projects. In dcvis, he
implemented significant new features, including
an "Energy" layer comparing data center
consumption to residential use and a "water
usage" layer with detailed comparisons. He also
refactored the methodology panel and
streamlined the display of water usage units.
For crater-js, McCzarny introduced the "Cilia
Hauler" helper mob with AI-driven movement and
redesigned unity bonuses for better UI
integration. He added a "patience" system for
characters, allowing them to exhibit autonomous
behavior when idle, and enhanced the game's
visuals with a new sky gradient background.
Further crater-js improvements included
movement tuning, more complex difficulty logic,
UI fixes, and a refactor of inventory change
communication. He also updated the McCzarny
repository by adding a GITHUB_TOKEN and
adjusting the ghsummary action workflow. In
ghsummary, he updated the application to
utilize the gemini-3.5-flash-lite and
gemini-3.6-flash models. Finally, for
chromium-daily-digest, he added more log
context, a missing summary, updated to use the
newest models, and included a favicon.
